texts.label: A
texts.title: City Car Club — how it works

paragraphs.text: Members of the City Car Club can book a car by the hour or by the day using the club’s app. Cars are parked in 12 reserved spaces around the city, each marked with a green sign.
Joining costs £30, which includes a check of your driving licence. To join, you must be at least 21 years old and have held a full licence for two years.

The hourly price includes fuel, insurance and parking in the reserved spaces. If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full at the end of your booking, please refill it using the fuel card kept in the car.
Cars must be returned to the same space they were taken from. A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning.
Please report any damage in the app before you start your journey. Members who fail to do so may be held responsible for it.

texts.label: B
texts.title: Southgate College — enrolling for evening classes

paragraphs.text: Enrolment for spring courses opens on 5 January. Places are limited, so we advise you to enrol early. You can enrol online or in person at the college reception.
Course fees must be paid in full when you enrol. Learners who receive certain benefits may be able to study for free; please bring a recent letter confirming your benefits.
If a course has fewer than eight learners one week before it starts, it may be cancelled. In this case, you will be offered a place on another course or a full refund.
Learners must attend at least 80 per cent of classes to receive a certificate.
Parking at the college is free after 6 pm, and learners can also use the library and computer rooms during their course. A café on the ground floor is open until 8 pm on weekdays.
If you cannot attend a class, please tell your tutor by email so that any handouts can be kept for you.

items.quote: each marked with a green sign
items.prompt: Club cars are parked in reserved spaces marked with a 1 ____.

explanation.en: “each marked with a green sign” → green sign. “12” is the number of spaces, not how they are marked.
explanation.kk: «each marked with a green sign» → green sign. «12» — белгі емес, орын саны.
explanation.ru: «each marked with a green sign» → green sign. «12» — число мест, а не то, чем они отмечены.

items.quote: which includes a check of your driving licence
items.prompt: The joining fee covers a check of the member’s 2 ____.

explanation.en: “includes a check of your driving licence” → driving licence (“licence” / “license” are also accepted).
explanation.kk: «includes a check of your driving licence» → driving licence (licence / license да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «includes a check of your driving licence» → driving licence (засчитываются и licence / license).

items.quote: The hourly price includes fuel, insurance and parking in the reserved spaces
items.prompt: The hourly price includes fuel, insurance and 3 ____.

explanation.en: “includes fuel, insurance and parking” → parking. “Fuel” and “insurance” are already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «includes fuel, insurance and parking» → parking. «Fuel» мен «insurance» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «includes fuel, insurance and parking» → parking. «Fuel» и «insurance» уже в предложении.

items.quote: If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full
items.prompt: Members should refill the tank if it is less than 4 ____ full.

explanation.en: Members refill “If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full”. The answer “a quarter” is two words, within the limit.
explanation.kk: Көлікке жанармай «If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full» болса құю керек. Жауап a quarter — екі сөз, шектен аспайды.
explanation.ru: Заправить машину нужно, «If the fuel tank is less than a quarter full». Ответ a quarter — два слова, в пределах лимита.

items.quote: A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning
items.prompt: Returning a car late without telling the club costs 5 ____.

explanation.en: The late charge: “A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning” → £25. £30 is the joining fee.
explanation.kk: Ескертусіз кешіккені үшін айыппұл: «A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning» → £25. £30 — кіру жарнасы.
explanation.ru: Штраф за опоздание без предупреждения: «A charge of £25 is made if a car is returned late without warning» → £25. £30 — вступительный взнос.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Read Text A. Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the text for each answer.

items.quote: Enrolment for spring courses opens on 5 January
items.prompt: Enrolment for spring courses starts on 6 ____.

explanation.en: Enrolment “opens on 5 January”. “Starts” in the sentence means “opens”, so the answer is 5 January.
explanation.kk: Көктемгі курсқа тіркелу «opens on 5 January». Сөйлемдегі «starts» — «opens» дегені, жауап 5 January.
explanation.ru: Запись на весенние курсы «opens on 5 January». «Starts» в предложении значит «opens», ответ 5 January.

items.quote: please bring a recent letter confirming your benefits
items.prompt: Learners on certain benefits should bring a recent 7 ____.

explanation.en: “bring a recent letter confirming your benefits” → letter. “Recent” is already in the sentence.
explanation.kk: «bring a recent letter confirming your benefits» → letter. «Recent» сөйлемде тұр.
explanation.ru: «bring a recent letter confirming your benefits» → letter. «Recent» уже в предложении.

items.quote: If a course has fewer than eight learners one week before it starts, it may be cancelled
items.prompt: A course may be cancelled if it has fewer than 8 ____ learners a week before it starts.

explanation.en: “fewer than eight learners one week before it starts” → eight (or 8). “One week” is the time, not the number of learners.
explanation.kk: «fewer than eight learners one week before it starts» → eight (немесе 8). «One week» — оқушы саны емес, мерзім.
explanation.ru: «fewer than eight learners one week before it starts» → eight (или 8). «One week» — срок, а не число учащихся.

items.quote: you will be offered a place on another course or a full refund
items.prompt: If a course is cancelled, learners can choose another course or a 9 ____.

explanation.en: “a place on another course or a full refund” → full refund (“refund” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «a place on another course or a full refund» → full refund (refund да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «a place on another course or a full refund» → full refund (засчитывается и refund).

items.quote: Learners must attend at least 80 per cent of classes to receive a certificate
items.prompt: To receive a certificate, learners must attend at least 10 ____ of classes.

explanation.en: A certificate requires learners to “attend at least 80 per cent of classes”. The answer 80 per cent (or 80%) fits the limit.
explanation.kk: Сертификат алу үшін «attend at least 80 per cent of classes» керек. Жауап 80 per cent (немесе 80%) — сан мен сөз шектен аспайды.
explanation.ru: Для сертификата нужно «attend at least 80 per cent of classes». Ответ 80 per cent (или 80%) — число и слова в пределах лимита.
